cases.title: Same title, different deliverables from creation
cases.canonicalBody: Create the Acme production tenant in eu-west-1 and connect employee single sign-on. Acceptance: employees can sign in to the tenant.
cases.body: Create a read-only service identity for the Acme finance exporter. Grant invoice export access only; it must not allow employee sign-in or create a tenant. Acceptance: the nightly finance export can authenticate.
cases.rationale: The two issues serve different principals and acceptance criteria. Both descriptions are unchanged from creation; matching titles are insufficient evidence of duplication.

cases.title: Different wording, redundant work
cases.canonicalBody: Configure Acme employees to sign in to the existing eu-west-1 tenant with the corporate identity provider. Completion means a staff member can log in through SSO. No new tenant is needed.
cases.body: Connect the company identity provider to the existing Acme tenant in eu-west-1 for staff authentication. Done when an employee successfully uses single sign-on. Do not provision another tenant.
cases.rationale: Different titles and prose describe the same tenant, identity provider, users, and acceptance condition. No extra deliverable exists.

cases.title: Accurate correction in different words
cases.canonicalBody: Create the Acme workspace and verify employee access.
cases.body: Create the Acme workspace and verify employee access.
cases.correction: Correction: Acme is not ready for handoff yet; verification remains outstanding. Use ticket #830 as the primary tracker. The extra ticket #831 has been closed, and Amara Okeke is responsible for the handoff.
cases.rationale: GitHub is already closed and the original owner was restored by a human. The paraphrased correction accurately describes the current state and must remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

cases.title: Conflicting original-owner records
cases.canonicalBody: Create the Acme tenant and verify access.
cases.body: Create the Acme tenant and verify access.
cases.rationale: The intake says Jordan Vale was the owner, while the recorded pre-change journal names Amara Okeke for the same handoff. Neither can establish a unique original owner; escalate without any writes.
